business_problem: As part of its effort to make gardening more effortless, AL-KO decided in 2018 that it wanted to improve the ability of its customers to control, monitor, and maintain their lawn mowers through an intuitive app.
solution_summary: AL-KO rebuilt its connectivity platform on AWS to connect robotic lawn mowers and other gardening devices to a new cloud backend and companion apps. The company used AWS IoT Core as the managed connectivity layer so devices could exchange telemetry and commands without AL-KO managing infrastructure, then built separate customer and service-partner applications on top of that backend. The consumer-facing AL-KO inTOUCH app lets customers remotely control and configure lawn mowers and integrate them into smart-home scenarios, while the partner app exposes device history, errors, and diagnostics so service organizations can troubleshoot remotely and prepare better support visits.

solution_components.name: AWS IoT Core
solution_components.role: Connects IoT devices securely to cloud ingestion and device-management services.

data_flow: Telemetry from connected lawn mowers flows through AWS IoT Core into AL-KO’s cloud backend, where customer and partner apps expose remote control, diagnostics, device history, and smart-garden automation scenarios.
business_outcome: AL-KO’s new AWS-based connectivity solution increases customer interaction, supports brand loyalty, and gives the company richer operational data to expand smart-garden features and future predictive capabilities.
